svg.title: Serenity UAV build guide 05 - CF CUTS AND MACHINED PARTS

svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
Fixed spar, tilt shafts, metal pinions, gear cheeks
CF tube 20 mm OD x 16.3 mm ID
Steel tube 4 mm OD x 0.5 mm wall,
CF flat bar 6 x 3 mm keel, 2
Cut both wing spars per docs/TILT_SPAR_ANALYSIS.md; deburr the ends.
Cut the two 4 mm tilt shafts; they run in BUSH-TILT-4MM bronze bushings.
Machine the 14T pinions in brass or steel from wing_tilt_pinion.scad.
Waterjet the 8 A1b backbone cheeks (2 per leg).
Cut the keel segments and the 2 ring-frame profiles.
CF dust is a respiratory and eye hazard. Wear an N95 and safety glasses; cut outdoors or with dust extraction.
Never print the tilt pinion. A printed pinion is below the 76 MPa allowable (NACELLE_64MM_VERIFICATION 5c).
SOURCE: REVN_BUILD_GUIDE_24IN.md Phase 0 CF Cuts and Machined Parts
